An operator restored the original manifest bytes; the existing process recovered through its automatic admission timer without a manual retry, relaunch or replacement.
Native terminal UI capture was unavailable. Screenshots show a labeled read-only browser viewer of actual Herdr terminal text, process snapshots and SQLite records.
Startup state and native transcripts are retained; processes and the owned Herdr server were stopped.
